cards.explanation: The answer is the Lord's mighty power. Paul says, "…be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power." (Ephesians 6:10) Notice where the strength comes from. It isn't from flexing in the mirror or from a pep talk to yourself. It comes from the Lord, and that's a relief to me, friends, because my arms are made of mustache.

The answer is to stand against the devil's schemes. Paul says to put on the full armor of God "…so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes." (Ephesians 6:11) The armor has a job, and the job is standing. Schemes are plans, so I think Paul wants the believers ready for whatever the devil cooks up.

The answer is False. Paul says, "For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms." (Ephesians 6:12) That's a long list, friends, and not one of them is a neighbor.

The answer is spiritual forces of evil. Paul says the struggle is against the rulers, the authorities, the powers of this world's darkness, "…and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms." (Ephesians 6:12) He says it plainly, friends. The struggle is not against flesh and blood.

The answer is evil. Paul says to take up the armor "…so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground…" (Ephesians 6:13) He says "when," not "if." So the armor gets put on ahead of time, bakers, just like an oven gets preheated.

The answer is the gospel of peace. Paul says, "…with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace." (Ephesians 6:15) Notice what goes on the feet, friends. It's the readiness of the gospel of peace.

The answer is True. Paul says, "…take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one." (Ephesians 6:16) All of them, friends, not just the small ones. I'd want that shield in my hand.

The answer is word. Paul says the sword of the Spirit "…is the word of God." (Ephesians 6:17) Friends, that's why we're here, picking up the Word one passage at a time. Paul says to take the sword, so the Word is something you pick up.

The answer is False. Paul says to "Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition." (Ephesians 6:18) At all times means all times, friends, not just the rough ones. I think that makes prayer more like a daily habit than an emergency button.

The answer is all the saints. Paul says to "…stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints." (Ephesians 6:18) That means they're praying for each other too. The prayer list is as wide as the whole family of believers.

The answer is words to share the gospel boldly. Paul asks them to pray "…that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel…" (Ephesians 6:19) Think about that, friends. Paul asks for help with the words, and that's what he puts first.

The answer is an ambassador in chains. Paul says the gospel is the thing "…for which I am an ambassador in chains." (Ephesians 6:20) An ambassador speaks for the one who sent him. So even in chains, Paul still has a message to deliver.

The answer is to tell them about Paul and encourage them. Paul says, "I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts." (Ephesians 6:22) Tychicus brings the news and the encouragement together, friends. A good friend delivers both.

The answer is God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Paul writes, "Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ." (Ephesians 6:23) That's where it comes from, friends. It's not something the believers have to bake up on their own.

The answer is False. Paul ends with "Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love." (Ephesians 6:24) The grace goes to all who love the Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love, not only to the leaders. That's a good way to end a letter, friends.
